idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: After this many minutes without a file event or tick, time stops counting until you come back. 1 to 240, default 5.

exclude.title: Excluded paths
exclude.description: Files whose open/save/focus time is not counted. Globs over the path: * within a segment, ** across segments, ? one character. A pattern without / matches the file name alone.
